Collapse an observed array value to one tidy cell

Source: R/parse.R
collapse_observed.Rd

BRREG returns addresses, vedtektsfestetFormaal, and aktivitet as arrays of register line-fragments of one value. Element text routinely contains commas and semicolons but never newlines, so "\n" is the only separator that survives a round trip: a consumer can split it back into the observed elements, which "; " and ", " do not allow. Arrays whose elements are objects (historiskeNavn, paategninger) are repeated observations of another unit and are nested instead: the cell is a tibble with one row per element and one column per leaf of the element, named in snake_case of the leaf's dot path, so the caller's column is a list-column that tidyr::unnest() expands.

Usage

collapse_observed(val)

Arguments

val

A list, atomic vector or data frame taken from a parsed response.

Value

A length-1 character value, or a tibble for an array of objects.
